doc: Walks an array of 0xC-byte entries starting at arg0, terminated by an entry whose flags byte (offset 0) has bit 0x80 set. For each entry whose flags byte has neither of bits 0x20/0x40 set, decrements a running s32* cursor (initialized to the array base reinterpreted as s32*, so it walks backward through memory preceding the array) and dispatches to func_80047468 (if D_80082E60's byte at offset 0xA equals 1) or func_80047338 (otherwise), passing the entry pointer, *arg1, and the dereferenced cursor value.

This is the SAME global as src/w_80040BB4.c's S_80082E60 (pad0[8]; union{u8 b;u16 h;} field_8; s8 pad_A; s8 field_B; ...) -- offset 0xA there is currently an unused 's8 pad_A' placeholder; needs to be renamed field_A and reconciled as u8 across both views. };
